name: Price Source Format Choice
definition: Choice of the source (place) of the price quotation.

LocalMarketPlace.name: Local Market Place
LocalMarketPlace.definition: Source of price quotation is the market, expressed as a Market Identifier Code (MIC).

NonLocalMarketPlace.name: Non Local Market Place
NonLocalMarketPlace.definition: Source of a price quotation when it is not the local market.

PlaceAsDSS.name: Place As DSS
PlaceAsDSS.definition: Source of a price quotation expressed with a propriety identification scheme.
